_meta.basis: Consolidated (Anthem Biosciences Ltd + 100% subsidiary NeoAnthem Lifesciences Pvt Ltd, Unit III). Rs crore unless stated. Every figure published on or before 30-Sep-2026.

jmInit.what: JM Financial initiating coverage (RHP-based customer, Davos and molecule data)

profile.founded: 2006, Bengaluru, by Ajay Bhardwaj (ex-Biocon), with Ganesh Sambasivam (ex-Syngene CSO) and K Ravindra Chandrappa
profile.listed: 21-Jul-2025 on NSE (ANTHEM) and BSE (544449); IPO price Rs570; 27% listing-day gain; listing-day market value ~Rs40,300 cr

shares.note: 56.17 cr shares at Mar-26 (2.64 mn ESOP shares issued in FY26); PL cites 563.38 mn after further ESOP allotments (22-Jul-2026)

profile.sites: Unit I Bommasandra (5 acres; 2007), Unit II Harohalli (15 acres; 2017), Unit III Harohalli (NeoAnthem, 8 acres; commissioned FY26), Unit IV Harohalli (30 acres; Phase I under construction)
profile.approvals: USFDA (four approvals at Unit I; two USFDA audits at Unit II), PMDA, TGA, ANVISA, EU-QP; AAALAC and GLP accredited

customers.fy25: 169 CRDMO customers (145 small pharma/emerging biotech, 16 mid, 8 large); >550 customers incl. specialty ingredients across 44+ countries (abridged)

fy26.dividendNote: Final dividend Rs2.00 a share (~Rs112.6 cr), recommended 19-May-2026, approved at the AGM of 22-Jul-2026

revenueMix.note: Commercial molecules 60.8% of revenue (AR p.35, Q4 deck); development & manufacturing batches for clinical molecules ~15% and R&D ~8-9% (CFO, 20-May-2026); D&M 14.5% (Q4 deck); R&D by difference

pipeline.note: Of the four FY26 commercialisations one is with a big pharma and three with emerging biotechs; all four Phase III additions in FY26 came from Anthem's own Phase II funnel (CFO, 20-May-2026)

fy26.src: ar26 (consolidated P&L p.253, notes 24, 41, 45); q4ppt; q4call

utilisation.unit2: ~50% custom synthesis (65% in FY26 after +130 KL); fermentation ~50% of 140 KL

q1fy27.orderBook: ~60% of the full year's revenue in hand, replenished after Q1 (CFO, 22-Jul-2026)
commentary: Revenue fell because customers deferred deliveries to Q2-Q4; Q1 called the softest quarter of the year; 'growth prospect for the full year remains intact... in line with our historical growth performance' (CFO)
No percentage guidance: 'We are not giving a guidance of any particular percentage' (CFO, asked whether the 20% target holds); BOBCAPS reads it as the 20% sales guidance retained

One new big-pharma customer being onboarded (agreement not yet signed; revenue in later quarters of FY27); a large biotech customer with a late Phase III development contract acquired by a big pharma (no near-term impact)
Semaglutide API ready but awaiting CDSCO approval, expected 'in a quarter or two'; domestic market first
Specialty ingredients hit by West Asia war supply-chain and raw-material disruption; growth expected by year-end
Employee cost ~13% and other expenses 9-10% of sales for FY27; ESOP cost Rs9 cr (FY26 Rs16 cr, FY28 ~Rs5 cr); tax 25-25.5% for FY27 as NeoAnthem turns break-even
q1fy27.src: q1ppt; q1call; Screener.in quarterly table (Jun-2026 column); BOBCAPS 22-Jul-2026 (segment gross margins)

otherIncomeNote.src: ar26 consolidated note 24; q4ppt and q1ppt footnotes

treasury.note: Non-current bank balances (AR note 7) sit in Screener's 'Other Assets'; we treat them as treasury (assumptions.otherTreasury). Bonds are mostly NBFC and housing-finance paper (Bajaj Finance, HDB, Chola, Kotak entities, Muthoot Fincorp, Hinduja Leyland). Renewable stakes are captive-power SPVs (Four EF, Ampyr, Isharays, Suryaurja), not treasury.
treasury.src: ar26 consolidated balance sheet and notes 4, 7, 12, 13, 17

segmentsHistory.note: RHP KPI EBITDA includes forex and export incentives but not treasury income; FY26 material margin = 1 - (materials + inventory change)/revenue from the AR P&L

unit4PhaseI.timing: Ground broken in FY26; civil work nearly done, equipment orders from Jul-2026; ready by end-FY28; capex split ~50:50 FY27/FY28
unit4PhaseI.later: Phases II-III after Mar-2028 could take capacity to ~3x today's

capacity.note: Unit II custom synthesis rose from 246 KL to 376 KL in FY26; Unit III commissioned in FY26 with peptide and high-potency (oncology) manufacturing
capacity.src: abridged (capacity table); q4call; q1call; q4ppt p.12

capex.guidance: FY27 ~Rs700 cr (Unit IV ~Rs600 cr + Unit II/III completion and maintenance); FY28 elevated with the second half of Unit IV; ~Rs500 cr after that (CFO, 20-May and 22-Jul-2026)
capex.src: Screener cash flow; ar26; q4call; q1call

neoanthem.outlook: Break-even and possibly profitable in FY27 (CFO, 22-Jul-2026)

history: Aug-2025 (first call): ~20% revenue growth, in line with a ~20% historical CAGR
Feb-2026: FY26 revenue growth cut to 15-16%; EBITDA and PAT growth 20%+ kept
FY26 delivered: revenue +15.2%, company EBITDA +30.8%, PAT +31.1%
May-2026: no FY27 guidance; 'aspire' to ~20% growth over the long term; EBITDA margin 38-40% 'we'll continue to deliver'
Jul-2026: 'growth prospects intact... in line with historical growth'; no percentage given

ipo.type: 100% offer for sale (no fresh issue; the company received nothing)
ipo.note: Ajay Bhardwaj and Ishaan Bhardwaj sold nothing. Offer expenses were borne by the selling shareholders. Weighted average cost per share in Rs (abridged prospectus).

timeline.event: Incorporated in Bengaluru as a discovery research and custom-synthesis provider

timeline.impact: Base of the discovery and development business

timeline.event: First USFDA approval for Unit I
Unit II (Harohalli) commissioned; fermentation capacity built
timeline.impact: Commercial-scale custom synthesis and fermentation; specialty ingredients grow

timeline.event: True North invests through Viridity Tone LLP (a second PE investment, per the AR); FY21 revenue +74% to Rs1,103 cr
timeline.impact: Crosses Rs1,000 cr revenue in its 14th year

timeline.event: Failure of a Phase III molecule and withdrawal of a commercial molecule; 12:1 bonus (Nov-2022)
Buy-back of 1.14 cr shares at Rs130.55 (~Rs149 cr)
Commercial molecules scale up; Unit II expansion; Unit III construction
timeline.impact: Revenue +34% and +30%; one intermediate sourced from China depresses material margin

timeline.event: IPO: Rs3,395 cr pure offer for sale at Rs570
Four client molecules commercialised; backward integration of the key intermediate; Unit II to 376 KL; Unit III commissioned; customer destocking
timeline.impact: Revenue +15%, PAT +31%; gross margin up ~4 points from H2
Rs24.4 cr exceptional charge in FY26

timeline.event: True North sells its last 3.62% (Rs1,262 cr at Rs621)
timeline.impact: PE exit complete; HDFC MF and SBI MF buy 1.65%

timeline.event: Promoter-group member Aruna Ganesh sells her entire 3.05% (Rs1,275 cr at Rs744.80)
timeline.impact: Promoter group 74.68% to 71.63%; foreign and domestic institutions buy
Stock unmoved; order book ~60% of the year

accounting.item: Company EBITDA includes all other income (FY26 Rs156 cr, of which Rs58 cr forex gains); Screener EBITDA excludes it
accounting.effect: Company FY26 margin 43.4% vs 39.3% on Screener's basis

accounting.item: Forex gains Rs58.4 cr in FY26 (Rs7.3 cr in FY25) on an 85% export book; Q1FY27 operating other income only Rs1.3 cr
accounting.effect: ~10% of FY26 PBT will not repeat at the same level

accounting.item: Treasury of ~Rs1,425 cr largely in NBFC bonds and market-linked debentures marked to market
accounting.effect: Credit and mark-to-market risk in other income

accounting.item: ESOP 2024 cost Rs34.3 cr (FY25), Rs15.9 cr (FY26), ~Rs9 cr (FY27E)
accounting.effect: Falling non-cash charge lifts reported margin growth

accounting.item: Sales returns Rs58.7 cr in FY26 (Rs6.1 cr in FY25) netted from revenue
accounting.effect: Worth watching in a lumpy, concentrated order book

accounting.item: NeoAnthem losses (Rs78.7 cr in FY26) carry no tax credit in the consolidated tax line
accounting.effect: FY26 tax rate 28.2%; normalises to ~25% as Unit III breaks even

siProducts.note: Mostly fermentation-made enzymes, the serratiopeptidase protease, vitamin analogues (incl. vitamin K2 MK-7), probiotics, nutritional actives (PQQ, S-equol) and some APIs; ~India and rest-of-world B2B buyers; new: semaglutide API (awaiting CDSCO approval) and a microbial biosimilar for a US customer
